title: Show Dropdown Chevron Affordance
description: UI dropdowns such as the example for playgrounds are currently not showing any chevron on the right, hence you currently cant see that it is dropdown compared to a button, etc. Fix so dropdowns show a visible chevron affordance on the right.
summary: Fixed unusably narrow fill distribution sliders by switching tree property rows from flex to a fixed control column grid (controlValueColumnUiSpacing, same as ControlTree/WindowMeasuresTree). Labels truncate; percentages removed from Rust group/vortex labels; weight sliders now read out as 50% on the slider value only (not in row labels). Vitest slider-width + buildToolTabs + cargo fill_and_brush tests passed.
